company.name: FightCamp
company.shortDescription: FightCamp provides on-demand boxing and HIIT workouts with motion trackers on wrists that track every punch thrown and every rep completed.
company.description:
FightCamp is on-demand boxing and HIIT workouts with motion trackers on wrists that track every punch thrown and every rep completed. It is built and led by real-life fighters. They’ve put it all on the line and know what it takes to become a champion. It delivers one of the toughest and most well-rounded workout experience.

FightCamp started its life in 2016 as “Hykso”, focusing initially on the sale of the punch tracking hardware. As the company shifted focus to include subscription content in 2018, the “FightCamp” name took over; now it seems to be used almost exclusively.

aiResearchSummary.text: FightCamp is researching modular interactive exercise and gaming systems and methods, focusing on user-friendly systems that extend the functionality of motion trackers by mechanically and electrically coupling tracker modules to consoles. Additionally, they are developing stabilized training apparatus, specifically lightweight training bag assemblies that replicate the punch-feel of heavy, ceiling-mounted punching bags while minimizing unwanted motion and sound. These efforts address interactive workout tracking and equipment design.
